about.label: About Me
about.title: Who I Am
about.p1: I'm Ayoub Elassri, a Full Stack Web Developer from Morocco specialized in Laravel, React.js, PHP and MySQL. I build modern web applications with clean architecture and high performance.
about.p2: During my training at OFPPT, I completed several practical projects including Tourist in Fes, a tourism booking platform, a Car Rental Management System, and this personal portfolio.
about.p3: I enjoy writing clean, maintainable code and continuously improving my technical skills while contributing to real-world software projects.
